values.note: Campspot lists about 29 RV sites (most 30-amp pull-throughs with water, 8 with 50 amps) taking rigs to 50 ft, plus primitive tent and hammock sites. The cheapest types that list motorhomes are the 30-amp pull-throughs with water ($37.50 on Campspot in Oct 2026); the 30-amp electric-only back-ins are rated 25-30 ft and do not list motorhomes.
